title: A code pane shows a file and marks lines on request
body:
The empty pane in `src/panes.rs` is a placeholder. Nothing can show a file.

## Proposal

A code pane: a decade-aware client that occupies a pane, opens a file, scrolls
to a line and marks ranges of lines, on messages from the socket. Read only;
whether it ever edits is a separate decision, as Jack said on 2026-11-05.

Two ways to build it:

| Option | Cost | Fit |
|---|---|---|
| A TUI in a ghostty pane | a small ratatui program, syntax colouring from a crate | runs anywhere, same shape as the chat |
| A native Wayland client drawing cells | its own renderer | pays for itself only with pixel features |

Lean: the TUI. It follows the TUI rule by construction and reuses whatever
the chat learns about rendering.

## Out of scope

- Editing.
- Multiple files side by side. The first version shows one file per pane;
  two files means two panes.
